<function name="MsgAll" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Works exactly like <page>Global.Msg</page> except that, if called on the server, will print to all players consoles plus the server console. Limitations of <page>Global.print</page> apply. </description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="args" type="vararg">List of values to print.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
